notes.Title: The setting KEY. Not unique - multi-row keys are the established pattern (AdminEmail, and now Classification / SystemTag / EquipmentTag).
notes.Value: Single-value settings hold the value directly (DayStartHour, SiteName, WeekendPolicy). Vocabulary rows hold pipe-delimited fields.
notes.Note: Free-text description for admins. Not read by the app.

vocabularyRows.Classification: code|label|rank|themeToken  e.g. OS|Official-Sensitive|20|StatusBusy. Rank is ordered and spaced by 10; the filter is 'rank >= selected', never equality. themeToken is an AppTheme token NAME - DS1 forbids raw hex outside the token block.

invariant: Every vocabulary key has an in-code default Table() in App.Formulas, mirroring the SettingNumber(key, dflt) pattern. An empty list must never mean an empty vocabulary.
